subject: Request: scope carve-out and short-term capacity for Palmetto activation
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Alex Hunt <alex.hunt@palmetto-fin.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: scope carve-out and short-term capacity for Palmetto activation

Marissa / Laura —

Quick context: Palmetto (see Alex cc'd) is at verbal commitment but legal/procurement flagged two items that need product/eng confirmation to sign this month:

1) Customer-controlled response redaction toggle — Palmetto's security team wants the ability to enable/disable PII redaction on a per-tenant basis via API for their first 90 days (they'll keep it on after review). They want an on/off config rather than an SDK change.

2) Guaranteed burst capacity for initial onboarding — they expect several large-batch replays during week 1. They are asking for a short-term capacity reservation (30 days) at ~4x baseline throughput while they warm up.

Attachments: SOW draft + a short spec on the toggle (redaction_toggle_spec.xlsx).

Can you confirm feasibility and a minimal scope we could ship as a carve-out (not a full product rollout) so we can close the deal? We need an internal commitment by EOD Friday so I can fold into procurement.

Asks:
- Rough engineering effort for a minimal toggle (backend flag + API) vs full UI + audit trails
- Can we provision a 30-day reserved pool (if so, cost delta and lead time)
- Any compliance blockers (Marissa) we should surface to the customer now

If useful I can put together a one-page mutual action plan — want to avoid engineering carrying the whole risk without commercial commitment.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: SOW_Draft_Palmetto_v1.pdf)
(Attachment: redaction_toggle_spec.xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Alex Hunt <alex.hunt@palmetto-fin.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T14:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: scope carve-out and short-term capacity for Palmetto activation

Diego —

Thanks for the clear ask and the spec. High level reaction from Product: both requests are reasonable but have different risk profiles.

Redaction toggle options (trade-offs):
- Minimal toggle (recommended for carve-out): a tenant-level boolean that flips an existing redaction pipeline on/off at ingress. No new UI; accessible via API only. Pros: low surface area, short delivery. Cons: less visible auditability for non-technical stakeholders. Estimated effort: backend work ~1.5 weeks, QA ~3 days, compliance review required.

- Full-feature toggle (long-term): includes UI, tenant audit trail, access controls and retention reports — 4–6 weeks.

Capacity reservation: Engineering + Infra will need a lead time to stand up a dedicated burst pool. If Palmetto signs, we can prioritize a 30-day dedicated burst but it requires a capacity reservation (procurement/finance to confirm chargeback) and 7–10 business days of runway from approval.

Compliance: we need a brief from Palmetto on retention preferences and which fields they consider PII for the toggle to be safe — otherwise we default to our standard redaction schema. Alex, can you provide that?

Next steps I propose:
1) Engineering scope decision: minimal toggle (API-only) vs full.
2) Commercial confirms cost for burst pool.
3) Mutual action plan doc that ties delivery to signature.

Diego — put the MAP in a shared doc and I'll assign an owner in Product to shepherd.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference

Cc: Alex Hunt <alex.hunt@palmetto-fin.com>, procurement@palmetto-fin.com
Date: 2026-05-05T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: scope carve-out and short-term capacity for Palmetto activation

Team —

From commercial: Palmetto is comfortable with a short-term carve-out as long as we: (a) tie delivery to signature in the MAP, and (b) take a small premium for the 30-day reserved burst (they're okay with credits or an add-on line-item). They want an explicit SLO delta if redaction is toggled off.

If Engineering can offer a minimal API-only toggle we can close this week. On the burst: I'm happy to propose a commercial structure that covers cost + 15% margin; need an estimate from Eng on expected incremental capacity cost for 30 days.

Also: Alex — procurement mentioned they need an explicit handoff plan for day-1 replay. Can you confirm the expected batch sizes?

-Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Deal Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Alex Hunt <alex.hunt@palmetto-fin.com>, Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@palmetto-fin.com>
Date: 2026-05-06T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: scope carve-out and short-term capacity for Palmetto activation

Diego / Marissa / Ben / Alex —

Thanks for the clear framing. Engineering has scoped two viable tracks and a recommended path for an enterprise carve-out: 

Tracks (estimate, inclusive of QA + smoke):
1) Minimal toggle (API-only, no UI, no extra audit stream):
   - Backend: 1.5 engineer-weeks (feature flag + config per-tenant)
   - QA and compliance regression: 3 engineer-days
   - Infra ops for toggle rollout and feature gating: 2 engineer-days
   - Risk: low, can ship behind a flag; no change to existing retention rules.
   - Delivery window: 10 business days from work start.

2) Full toggle (UI + audit trail + admin controls):
   - Backend: 3–4 engineer-weeks
   - Frontend: 2 engineer-weeks
   - QA/compliance: 1 week
   - Delivery window: 6–8 weeks.

Burst capacity (30 days):
- We can provision a dedicated burst pool via Dedicated offering; operational lead time is 7 business days from approval. Estimated incremental cost: approx $18k for 30 days at requested 4x baseline (ballpark — Infra to confirm).

Recommended plan for closing:
- Ship Track 1 (minimal toggle) as a carve-out tied to signature — go/no-go decision required within 48 hours to meet procurement timelines.
- Bill burst capacity as a 30-day add-on in SOW (Ben to confirm pricing). Engineering will schedule work as high priority after go/no-go.

I created a quick Jira ticket to track the work: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INFRA-2147 — please add the MAP and acceptance criteria there.

Mutual action plan (short):
- Day 0: Signed SOW + MAP (Procurement)
- Day 1–7: Infra prep for burst (ops + finance confirmation)
- Day 8–18: Engineering implements minimal toggle and runs customer smoke tests
- Day 19–30: Monitor, iterate, handoff to CS

Alex / Sofia — please confirm PII fields and expected batch sizes for the replay so we can finalize the SOW numbers. If you're comfortable with this plan, Diego, I'll book the first implementation slot for next week.

Laura Bennett
Staff Engineering Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: implementation_estimate.csv)
